title: الحُرُوفُ الشَّمْسِيَّةُ وَالقَمَرِيَّةُ
blocks: ## Use the chapter at the depth you need
- Pronounce الـ correctly in common words.
## One written article, two pronunciation patterns
The ل is not heard. The Sun letter is doubled.
[callout] Essential distinction: the spelling still contains الـ in both cases. The difference is mainly pronunciation and the shadda placed on the Sun letter.
[callout] Sun sequence: ت ث د ذ ر ز س ش ص ض ط ظ ل ن

TABLE: Word | Pronunciation pattern | What to notice // التُّفَّاحُ | at-tuffāḥ | Shadda on ت . // الثَّلْجُ | ath-thalj | Shadda on ث . // الدَّرْسُ | ad-dars | Shadda on د . // الرَّجُلُ | ar-rajul | Shadda on ر . // الشَّارِعُ | ash-shāriʿ | Shadda on ش . // النَّاسُ | an-nās | Shadda on ن .
[callout] Moon sequence: أ ب ج ح خ ع غ ف ق ك م ه و ي

TABLE: Word | Pronunciation pattern | What to notice // الأَبُ | al-ab | The ل is heard. // البَيْتُ | al-bayt | No shadda on ب . // الجَبَلُ | al-jabal | The ل remains clear. // القَلَمُ | al-qalam | Qāf is a Moon letter. // المَدْرَسَةُ | al-madrasah | Mīm is a Moon letter. // اليَوْمُ | al-yawm | Yāʾ is a Moon letter.
The shadda tells the reader that a consonant is doubled. With Sun letters, it represents the assimilation of the ل sound into the next consonant.
[callout] Orthographic discipline: write the ل in the definite article even though it is not pronounced in the Sun pattern.

## Listen, speak, read and write with the pattern
Listen without looking. Ask a partner or reader to say each noun twice, then label it Sun or Moon in the same order.
الشَّارِعُ · البَيْتُ · النَّاسُ · القَمَرُ · السَّمَاءُ · المَطْعَمُ · الرَّجُلُ · الكِتَابُ · الطَّائِرَةُ · الوَلَدُ
Sun · Moon · Sun · Moon · Sun · Moon · Sun · Moon · Sun · Moon.
Write the ten Sun or Moon classifications on paper in order, then return here to check and mark the task complete.
